summary: Iris backend + frontend tested end-to-end within the constraints of the missing OAuth credentials. 18/18 pytest cases pass against the public URL, covering root health, /api/auth/session (authenticated=false), /api/auth/discord/login returning explicit 503 with missing-vars message and no secret leakage, /api/auth/logout, and 401 enforcement on every members/tickets route (list, stats, create, get, patch, sync). Static invariants confirmed in source: Discord API calls are pinned to guild 1081957992188088391 (member lookup path, channel guild_id check), history pagination uses limit=100 + before with page[-1]['id'], Mongo queries project out _id, .env pins the correct guild and does not expose a bot token. UI: LoginPage renders on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844), Discord button href correct, footer present, clicking the button surfaces the exact 503 message ('Connexion Discord à configurer : DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET, APP_SESSION_SECRET.') without leaking any secret. Direct navigation to /new correctly falls back to the login page because AuthenticatedApp only mounts when authenticated. The Transcription / Note / Vocal panels and save/sync buttons cannot be exercised live without an OAuth session, but the required data-testids (new-ticket-form, create-ticket-button, ticket-notes-input, ticket-vocal-input, save-ticket-button, sync-ticket-button, discord-login-button, transcript-panel, notes-panel, vocal-panel, archive-ticket-button) are all present in the source.

Minor: In frontend/src/App.js `updateTicket`, the stats recomputation uses the stale `tickets` closure — safe today because stats are refetched from /tickets/stats on mount, but consider recomputing from the merged list instead.
Minor: Remove unused `current_helper` import in backend/routers/auth.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth guard is enforced consistently on every members/tickets endpoint via Depends(current_helper). Verified with 7 live 401 responses and a forged-cookie negative test.
Discord scoping is defense-in-depth: member lookup uses /guilds/{DISCORD_GUILD_ID}/members/{id} AND fetch_text_channel verifies channel.guild_id == DISCORD_GUILD_ID before any history call. Good.
Pagination in fetch_channel_history is correct: limit=100, before=page[-1]['id'], stops when page < 100. Rate-limit 429 handled with retry_after sleep.
MongoDB _id is projected out in every tickets query (list, find_one via ticket_or_404, find_one for duplicate channel check). Ticket model correctly stores id as a UUID string.
Session cookies use HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax, and are HMAC-SHA256 signed with APP_SESSION_SECRET; forged cookies are rejected. Good.
OAuth config is validated lazily with a 503 message that lists ONLY the missing env var names — no secret values are ever echoed. Good.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — this is technically ineffective (browsers ignore * when credentials=true) but harmless in this environment. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the frontend origin once deployed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (login + 503 surface + route guard) — authenticated workspace flows not testable without OAuth credentials
